notes.content: Fixed a bug where going in and out of the party menu might cause you to lose characters.

notes.title: September 26 hotfix
notes.content: Fixed a bug in the latest version where players sometimes couldn't recruit new characters.

notes.title: Update for beta version September 26, 2024
notes.content:
- Controller support: Fur and Fables now supports Xbox gamepad and PS controllers.
- Selective level up: Instead of leveling - up automatically, you now gather points and use them to upgrade your characters.
- Level - up points stay with you between stages, and are also used to buy / recruit new characters, so you can farm for them using low level characters.
- Switch character places within the party: a much requested feature, you can now freely switch between your characters' positions during the game.
- Balance updates
- Bug fixes

We'd love to hear your feedback and of course if you encounter any issues!
